semantic.justification: TaskGKVVR7 connects source standard automatic row-height arithmetic and genuine compressed geometry/flags to current FontHeight UI and attribute Undo/Redo. Original contiguous pool defaults extend through ATTR_MARGIN143. Standard uniform-script unwrapped/unrotated rows use native 256-twip startup minimum,23-twip correction,margin/emphasis and pixel-change conditions. Selected sheets retain one original shared context. React uses actual row segments and bounded physical scrolling; ODS row styles apply to real sheet storage. Device-based initialization/script scanning,rich/wrapped/rotated/merged layout,drawing/hidden rows and standalone height dialogs remain unported. Nonstandard represented attribute profiles decline adjustment;unrepresented foreign layout properties,mixed-script text and device layout remain unverified. Writer primary saving/no-recovery/visible-content policy is retained; broad parity remains unverified. Task76 adds original copy-reference context values, insertion-only global-name normalization, sparse column sets, ScFormulaCell copy-update/compile metadata and actual document/table/column copy traversal with boundary group joins. Compiled references remain owned by the existing token arrays; no formula-source reparse is used to relocate references. Native false returns, oldest on-move undo formula and optional block-position borrowing are retained. Non-copy shift/move engines and absent names/drawing/printing/validation/embedded/UNO/formatter services remain unrepresented. This prerequisite does not complete document CopyFromClip, paste history, EnterBlock or AutoSum acceptance; whole-module behavior/contract/default parity stays unverified. Native table1 UpdateReference now forwards to the real conditional-format list after column traversal;cache values are reset even for nonintersecting copied cells. Original list UpdateReference prunes empty ranges only in URM_INSDEL. Broader sheet insert/delete/move token/table consumers remain unported and are not replaced by a SetTabNo shortcut.
